meta.title: 领导问「你有把握吗」？谨慎拍胸脯才是正解
meta.title_en: How to Answer 'Can You Handle It?'

scenes.title_en: A dilemma: to admit or to promise
scenes.context: 领导问「你有把握吗」，说实话怕被换人，拍胸脯太快领导又不放心。
sentences: 领导问你这件事情你有把握吗，实际情况是你只有五成把握。
Your manager asks if you're sure you can handle it, and honestly you're only half sure.
有把握：be confident / be sure of it
如果你说实话我没把握，领导会很生气。
If you admit you're not sure, your manager will get upset.
说实话：be honest / come clean
你拍胸脯拍得太快了，领导还是不放心。
You promise way too quickly, and your manager still doesn't trust it.
拍胸脯：make a promise
paraphrase: 说实话怕被换，拍胸脯怕打脸
Honesty scares off your manager, and over-promising backfires.
立刻表态 → 先想再答
From answering instantly to thinking before you promise.
scenes.speak: Your manager asks if you're sure you can handle it, and honestly you're only half sure. If you admit you're not sure, your manager will get upset. You promise way too quickly, and your manager still doesn't trust it.

scenes.title_en: The trap of "I'll try my best"
scenes.context: 讲事实不承诺让领导问了个寂寞；说「我会尽力」在英文里 try to do 本身就暗示可能做不成。
sentences: 讲事实不承诺，领导问了半天问了个寂寞。
Listing facts without committing just leaves your manager with nothing.
问了个寂寞：end up with nothing
try to do 的意思是有可能做不成。
Try to do something means you might not pull it off.
有可能做不成：might not make it
manage to do 的意思是想尽办法能做成。
Manage to do something means you find a way to get it done.
想尽办法：find a way
paraphrase: 含糊表态 → 确定性语言
From vague promises to definite language.
Trying hard isn't the same as getting it done.
scenes.speak: Listing facts without committing just leaves your manager with nothing. Try to do something means you might not pull it off. Manage to do something means you find a way to get it done.

scenes.title_cn: 谨慎拍胸脯，变化就汇报
scenes.title_en: Promise carefully, then report every change
scenes.context: 拍还是要拍，但要先想再承诺；有变化苗头立即带方案汇报，领导怕的是跟不上变化和没思路。
sentences: 拍还是要拍的，但要拍得慢一点，先想一想然后再承诺。
Yes, you should commit — but slowly. Think it through first.
先想一想：think it through
一有变化的苗头，马上向领导继续汇报。
The moment something shifts, report it to your manager right away.
变化的苗头：the first sign of change
领导怕的不是变化，而是跟不上变化和你没有思路。
Managers don't fear change; they fear you falling behind it without a plan.
没有思路：have no plan
paraphrase: 领导要态度和思路，不是承诺本身
Managers look for attitude and thinking, not just promises.
scenes.speak: Yes, you should commit — but slowly. Think it through first. The moment something shifts, report it to your manager right away. Managers don't fear change; they fear you falling behind it without a plan.

practice: I'm confident I can handle it.
Let me think it through before I commit.
I'll keep you posted the moment anything changes.
I'm worried I'll fall behind the change without a plan.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I will try my best to finish it.
✓ 地道说法：I'll get it done and keep you posted.
try my best 在商务英语里暗示可能做不到，换成确定表达。
✓ 地道说法：Commit carefully, don't rush your promise.
拍胸脯是中文比喻，英文直接用 commit / promise。
✕ 直译腔：The leader asked for half a day and got nothing.
✓ 地道说法：My manager ended up with no clear answer.
问了个寂寞→得不到明确答案。
✕ 直译腔：You don't have a thought path.
✓ 地道说法：You have no plan when things change.
没有思路→没有应对方案。
shifts: 说实话怕挨骂，拍胸脯怕打脸
谨慎拍胸脯：先想再承诺
把「我会尽力」当稳妥表态
用确定性语言表态，try 暗示做不成
变化苗头立即带方案汇报，给足安全感
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「拍胸部」校正为「拍胸脯」、「气魔」校正为「寂寞」、「领导指使」校正为「领导心里」、「信稿」校正为「信号」、「主攻」校正为「注意」；结尾被 Whisper 误识别成外语的乱码句已按语境省略。
